register_feature: register a custom protein feature with a name, TensorFlow dtype, and shape tuple into the FEATURES registry
shape: compute the concrete tensor shape for a named protein feature by replacing NUM_RES and NUM_SEQ placeholders with actual values
FeatureType: use the FeatureType enum to classify protein features as ZERO_DIM, ONE_DIM, TWO_DIM, or MSA based on their tensor dimensionality
FEATURES: inspect the FEATURES dictionary to look up the TensorFlow dtype and shape definition for any built-in AlphaFold protein feature
FEATURE_TYPES: use the FEATURE_TYPES dictionary to quickly look up the TensorFlow dtype for any registered protein feature by name
